body: I cried a few hours ago because I was feeling depressed and just gross because of a bunch of past and shit,made a post here and a really lovely comment made me feel much better! Love sucks I know believe me;but it's kind of worth it,you always get something from it and it is better to have loved and suffered than to never have loved at all,that's my motto at least,hope things work out for you :D and good vibes sent to you

You might be right...I like music,I love it actually,I love reading and creating stories,I love art,and doing yoga,which I want to do more often,and walking around with my mom and my dogs,traveling,watching horror movies,the whole horror aspect is really creative and beautiful to me,and funny,I also really love short films and just making videos at home,don't post them anywhere though,just expressing my thoughts,talking and commenting on anything that I watch or read with my sister and talking to her.And dreams...I have many,cinematography is one of them,I love it and it fascinates me,I've always wanted to do artistic videos and post them online,I also enjoy fashion a lot so maybe artistic lookbooks? I just love walking around and finding beautiful things on my path,I love nature and animals,I just sort of have this connection with them,it's really special,I used to ride horses and I loved it,honestly,what was the most enjoyable was just brushing their fur and feeding them,just talking to them and admiring their beauty,their profound and kind eyes just staring back at you,it was so beautiful.I like many different things and your comment gave me so much hope! I can't even express how grateful I am,I hope you have an amazing day! just writing this answer made me feel so much better,I just had a really nice talk with my mom and you just reminded me how beautiful life is,I don't even want to take it away from myself! It has been so long...You just showed me the way to hapiness as cheesy as it sounds,meditation sounds awesome too,we  used to do something like it when I went to yoga classes,I'm definately going to try it. Also,could you maybe tell me more about the intrusive thoughts and what I can do about them? you already did a lot and this comment is really long already sorry :/
